タイトル: Sophisticated software without the usual complexity
投稿者: Dustin アメリカのOwner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 不動産, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Sophisticated software without the usual complexity"
良い点: Elegant interface, unusually strong guest communication, sophisticated automation, and integrations that feel coherent rather than bolted on. The team is also notably responsive and technically fluent.
改善点: A handful of highly specialized workflows could use slightly more configurability, but the team seems responsive in improving the product with anything that I have brought to them.

タイトル: Can't recommend Hospitable enough - ideal for most small to medium size STR operators
投稿者: Daniel アメリカのOwner operator 認証済みLinkedInユーザー ホスピタリティ, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Can't recommend Hospitable enough - ideal for most small to medium size STR operators"
良い点: Extremely intuitive for someone not technically savvy and functionality and reliability are top notch. It is great software both via the app and the website. Customer service is excellent and rarely needed.
改善点: I've had very few complaints and can't think of anything overarching to warn someone about. I guess part of its ease of use is that it focuses on the most needed functionality for someone operating a property, but doesn't necessarily give you all the bells and whistles that more expensive software might offer.

タイトル: Easy to Use and Feature-Rich, but Human Support Is Slow
投稿者: Megan アメリカのManaging Owner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 不動産, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Easy to Use and Feature-Rich, but Human Support Is Slow"
良い点: Hospitable is ever expanding, adding new AI-forward, and admin-reducing features that make life easier.
改善点: Human support is incredibly hard to reach. There is no phone support. And while they offer help articles and AI-chat, if you need a person, you have to wait at least two days, which is ridiculous.

タイトル: Phenomenal - I have tried it all - finally a company that deserves 5 stars in so many ways
投稿者: Jonathan アメリカのFounder 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "Phenomenal - I have tried it all - finally a company that deserves 5 stars in so many ways"
良い点: - $7/listing - No setup costs - Enabled automation of 90% of my communications - I can review communications that are scheduled automatically BEFORE they go out - They don't want a percentage of my COMPANY to provide a killer service ( no % of sales model ) - They are under priced and over deliver - They under sell and overdeliver I have tried SO many tools!! Guesty and Tokeet were so glitchy they cost me money to try to setup. Guesty wanted $1000 just to set me up AND a PERCENTAGE OF MY COMPANY ( % of gross sales ) STAY AWAY from any company like that! Wheelhouse automated my prices, for a PERCENTAGE OF MY COMPANY - meh. Guesty promised to scale my ads and failed miserably. Tokeet's chat feature was garbage, but import/export listing feature was awesome. In the end, you can only hook up one channel manager to your airbnb account, so if your like me, you have got to decide on one at a time. I have tried 8 and reviewed 50-60... and Im done looking. SmartBNB delivered in almost every way I could have wanted. - Dirt cheap for what you get - Perfect communications channel w guests ( I am super picky ) - Seamless automated messages WITH THE ABILITY TO REVIEW THEM BEFORE THEY GO OUT - Bad Review strategies and are automated, rational, and effective - Almost instant, and intelligent customer service - Killer Documentation that actually trains you and almost never confuses you - Phenomenal - like off the charts phenomenal customer service tools.
改善点: - The calendar viewing is weak. Its fine because you can just use Airbnbs... but to improve it guys: clicking to go to the next month? Really? You cant scroll to Jan 15th to feb 15th? Fix that. Make it scroll like airbnbs please immediately. I don't touch that, but again, its not really a point against the company because you don't actually need to use it, I can get everything from the airbnb cal with info imported via Ical from the other sites.

投稿者: Julian 英国のMD 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 不動産, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Good entry level PMS"
良い点: Good value for money PMS - Did the basic channel manager functions that we needed at the time(Combined inbox, channel sync.)
改善点: I don't like the name! When I used it it was called SmartBNB - I also don't know how it's developed with integrations with other OTA's.

タイトル: Lack of Customer Service Overshadows the Product
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー マーケティング、広告, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Lack of Customer Service Overshadows the Product"

改善点: Customer service and billing flexibility. A same-day payment issue caused by a card change was resolved within approximately one hour, yet resulted in permanent loss of a legacy rate with no discretion or escalation path offered. The support ticket was later closed due to a holiday without resolution.

タイトル: Easy to use, good value, but lacks a few features
投稿者: Danny アメリカのOwner ホスピタリティ, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Easy to use, good value, but lacks a few features"

タイトル: Better than a real life property management company!

タイトル: Best PMS on the market and can't wait for their growth.
投稿者: Kevin アメリカのMarketing Director 不動産, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Best PMS on the market and can't wait for their growth."
良い点: It's extremely user friendly and so easy to use but extremely powerful. They have really developed a product that can streamline a ton of the processes in your short term rental business. Other software on the market are over priced and extremely difficult to use.
改善点: Website feature is still in development stages at time of this review. Also, I would like to see more integrations. Lastly, I think the metrics/financial reporting feature can be improved. I would like to be able to see more organized data about the health/growth of my properties so I can send a nice branded report to my property owners.

投稿者: Kristen アメリカのProperty Manager 不動産, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "A wonderful sanity saver!"

改善点: Not sure I have a "least" to like! Hmmm... My only regret is that I didn't start using Hospitable sooner!

タイトル: I absolutely love this company and their software
投稿者: Shevi イスラエルのproperty management ホスピタリティ, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "I absolutely love this company and their software"
良い点: *Very friendly and easy to use. Intuitive, simple and clear. great features: *scheduled messages before, after and during stay *automatic revives. *cleaver coding - identifies the topic of people's questions and replays with a prepared answer. * Fantastic statistical tools displaying data about performance, revenue, conversations with guests etc. *You have the option for automatic replay in multiple languages - based on the guests language. *full control over how much of the software you want involved in your work. *Very affordable, and definitely worth my money. *superb customer service.
改善点: I honestly love the software, have no complains. they used to send automatic daily updates about the ranking of the listing, which was a very helpful tool. You can still access the information now, but you need to get into the app and request for it and it's not automatic anymore. It's not a real problem, but I liked the automatic updates much more.

投稿者: Trey アメリカのOwner 不動産, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Hospitable review"
良い点: Hospitable has been critical in managing my calendar with multiple booking sites. The auto responses after bookings and inquiries saves so much time. I have created templates to send check-in instructions for each unit and Communication with the client is on auto pilot.
改善点: I don’t have much bad to say about Hospitable. It has done everything I’ve needed.

タイトル: Sehr gute Gästebenachrichtigung und guter Support
投稿者: Peter ドイツのManager ホスピタリティ, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Sehr gute Gästebenachrichtigung und guter Support"
良い点: Der Funktionsumfang dieser Software, die auch ständig weiterentwickelt wird, hat mich überzeugt. Am meisten nutze ich die automatiserten Benachrichtigungen an die Gäste, die keine Wünsche offen lassen. Meine Gäste schreiben mir überschwängliche Bewertungen bei AirBnB, vor allem über meine schnellen Rückmeldungen, die zum großen Teil automatisierte Nachrichten sind. Sehr positiv ist auch der direkte Draht über eine Chatfunktion zum Support, wo man Tag und Nacht Antworten auf seine Fragen und die notwendige Hilfestellung erhält. Ich habe auch schon mehrere Verbesserungen angeregt, die innerhalb weniger Tage und Wochen umgesetzt wurden und damit allen Nutzern zur Verfügung standen.
改善点: Die Benutzeroberfläche der Software ist selbst nach dem letzten großen Release immer noch wenig ansprechend. Die Menüstruktur und die englischen Menüberschriften sind gewöhnungsbedürftig und nicht intuitiv. Andere Sprachen außer Englisch sind wohl vorgesehen aber m.W. zur Zeit noch nicht erhältlich. Die Kalenderübersicht ist ein langer Balken, der je nach Bildschirmgröße noch nicht einmal einen Monat anzeigt (bei Handys noch viel weniger). Hier muss dringend nachgebessert werden. Dennoch sind das Kleinigkeiten bei einem ansonssten hervorragenden Produkt.

投稿者: Michelle アメリカのowner レジャー、旅行、観光, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "LOVE LOVE LOVE"

改善点: I have one little glitch in the task area. I can't click on the circle to schedule a cleaner because it sends the wrong date but we did figure out that I can do it from the operations list and it is right.

タイトル: Thanks to smartbnb keeping our response rates very high while saving our time !

投稿者: Christine カナダのPresident/Owner レジャー、旅行、観光, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Simply the best"

No other messaging tool compares to this and it's automated 95% of my communication, and given me over 800 reviews on OTA's praising how good our communication is. Fantastic customer support too and easy to set up once you understand how the tool can be used.
改善点: It only works on Airbnb and VRBO and I wish I could use it for emails and other OTA's.

投稿者: Kami アメリカのCEO ホスピタリティ, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Get your life back!"
良い点: Before I started using SmartBnb I was anxious all the time about missing an inquiry or a booking request. I remember not even being able to really enjoy my time off because I had none. I run 18 listings now. I work less than 3 hours a week now that my systems are all set up in Smarbnb. It's not the easiest to stop and think through what and when the messaging goes out. But it's not the software's fault. It takes a lot of energy process to map your business. The easiest way for me was to whiteboard it and write down the life cycle of a guest. Once you do you will only need minor tweaks after that. I could not be more pleased with Smartbnb. It's so stinking smart!!! Don't waste another minute worrying about your business, systematize it! You will love it.
改善点: It's difficult to get started. There are a lot of moving pieces. You have to know which listing gets what messaging all the time and which ones getst the unique messaging.

タイトル: Time Saved Makes it Well Worth It

良い点: Allows me to stay in contact with guests proactively - before, during, and after a guest stays with us. Automating the email sequence means information is never missed going to the guests. Using short codes is nice to not have to write blocks of text repeatedly. Also, the short codes are nice when I need to update small aspects of text, I can write the sentence structure around a short code so updating something like a door code is very easy
改善点: The idea of being able to recognize what the a guest is asking and respond appropriately is an amazing idea --- but we've not gotten it to work consistently enough (or barely at all) to rely on it. So questions still need be answered manually most of the time (although the saved responses do make it quicker!)

タイトル: Smartbnb keeps me organized and makes me look awesome.

良い点: I love that I am able to set-up and schedule specific messages to potential future guests and guests from everything to inquiry requests, to check-in instructions, to review reminders. Also, the property manager and the cleaning team receives automated messages upon a booking confirmation, as soon as I do once a guest has booked my property. Because I utilize Smartbnb, I am able to keep my response time at 100% on the Airbnb platform, something that Airbnb looks at when evaluating Superhost status.
改善点: I don't really have any cons as I know no other software experience like this and I have had awesome success with the implementation and use.

投稿者: Yaroslav チェコのInvestor 不動産, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Best money spent"
良い点: I most love that this software allows to automate 80% of communication with guests. I never have to worry about check-in instructions, parking instructions, leaving reviews and many other small communication things. I love the price of Smartbnb as it's very affordable for anyone doing short term rentals. And the support has always been quick and amazing.
改善点: It's not magic. You have to sit down and learn and try and test certain features. So it does take some time to learn what are the best settings that suit your needs as the software can be customised in incredible detail.

投稿者: Angela アメリカのHost ホスピタリティ, 自営業 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Great for hosts"
良い点: This software helps manage the recurring messages needed to be sent to hosts. It helps the experience feel personal to the guest and allows us to quickly provide all the necessary information to guests at the most relevant time intervals before, during and after their stay.
改善点: There are functionalities that can be included to improve operations - such as messaging to cleaners - that would make this software more holistic in its applicability. There is limited functionality to message all cleaners on your "team" but something that would be useful would be the ability to have auto message sent to certain cleaners (i.e. those you have allocated to clean on a certain day), allow for confirmation type responses with cleaners and other use cases to bring the operations piece truly on board to this platform.
